idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: Is Your Toilet Secretly Running Up Your Water Bill?
description: A leaking toilet can waste hundreds of gallons of water every month without making a sound. One simple way to check is the food coloring test. Remove the tank lid and add a few drops of dark food dye into the water. Wait about fifteen minutes without flushing. If the dye appears in the toilet bowl, your flapper or flush valve seal needs attention. You can also listen for faint running water long after a flush. Catching small leaks early helps protect your home from unnecessary water waste and higher bills. If replacing the flapper does not solve the issue, contact a licensed plumber for a thorough inspection.
